function.name: grep
function.description: Search markdown files for lines containing every space-separated term, case-insensitively and in any order. Use a few keywords, not a full question. Returns file, line, and matching text.

pattern.description: A few space-separated keywords. Every term must appear on tyhe same line; use terms without punctuation.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List all markdown files in corpus folder.

folder.description: Corpus folder to list files from

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a markdown file from corpus folder. Path must be corpus-relative file path copied from grep/list_files results; not a URL. Path must include corpus/ prefix and match a path returned by grep or list_files.

path.description: Path to the markdown file to read. Copy complete path from grep/list_files, including corpus/ and subfolders. Never pass just filename. Correct example: corpus/advanced/advanced-dependencies.md
